title: 3.12 Have and Has
unit_outcome: Introduce yourself and others in Spanish: name, age, where you are from, your job and what you have.
goal: Say what people have with tener: Tengo un libro. Ella tiene una bicicleta.
grammar_function: tener: tengo, tienes, tiene, tenemos, tienen + un/una/mi/su + noun.
speaking_outcome: Say who has what and whose it is.
